def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=[v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg=max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    if not pts: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # Each adjacent equal-color diagonal pair defines the outward continuation ray(s).
    pairs=set()
    for r,c in pts:
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==grid[r][c]:
                pairs.add((r,c,rr,cc,grid[r][c]))
    for r,c,rr,cc,col in pairs:
        dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
        # For both ends of the segment, continue outwards if next step exits object bbox.
        for sr,sc,vr,vc in ((r,c,-dr,-dc),(rr,cc,dr,dc)):
            nr,nc=sr+vr,sc+vc
            if r0<=nr<=r1 and c0<=nc<=c1: continue
            while 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w:
                if out[nr][nc] not in (bg,col): break
                out[nr][nc]=col
                nr+=vr; nc+=vc
    return out
